title: 15 women rescued from suspected illegal recruitment apartment in Manila

blocks.text: Fifteen women bound for Kuwait to work as domestic helpers were rescued by the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and the Manila Police District (MPD) during a joint operation at an apartment in San Andres Bukid, Manila, on Thursday, November 5.
